triples.evidence_text: Sounding pipes installed in compartments, such as cargo holds, where they may be exposed to mechanical damage, are to be adequately protected.

triples.tail_surface: doubler plate fitted at the tank bottom in way of the sounding pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在测深管处舱底加装复板
triples.evidence_text: Provision is to be made to protect the tank bottom plating from repeated striking by the sounding device. Such provision may be a doubler plate fitted at the tank bottom in way of the sounding pipe, or equivalent.

triples.tail_surface: terminate on or above the freeboard deck
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 终止于干舷甲板或以上
triples.evidence_text: Sounding pipes of double bottom tanks and tanks whose boundaries extend to the shell at or below the deepest load water line are, in addition, to terminate on or above the freeboard deck. This is so that in the event of a shell damage in way of the tank, the opening of the sounding pipe will not cause inadvertent flooding of internal spaces.

triples.tail_surface: closing device fitted at the open end is a gate valve, or screw cap
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 开口端安装闸阀或螺帽关闭装置
triples.evidence_text: Termination below the freeboard deck is permitted, however, if the closing device fitted at the open end is a gate valve, or screw cap.
